Rather than sifting through thousands of irrelevant listings, you gain immediate access to opportunities within your field. These platforms understand the unique terminology, qualifications, and career pathways specific to your industry, making it easier to find roles that match your skill set.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Benefits of Niche Career Platforms\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Industry-focused websites typically offer more than just job listings. They provide specialized resources tailored to your profession, including industry news, certification information, salary benchmarking specific to your field, and networking opportunities with professionals in similar roles. This comprehensive approach transforms these platforms into valuable career development tools rather than simple job boards.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Many niche platforms also feature employers who specifically seek candidates with industry experience. This means you're competing in a more targeted pool where your specialized knowledge is valued and understood. Recruiters on these platforms typically have deeper industry expertise, leading to more meaningful conversations about your qualifications and career goals.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Choosing the Right Industry Platform\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"When selecting an industry-specific platform, consider factors such as the platform's reputation within your field, the quality and quantity of listings, available networking features, and additional resources offered. Some industries have multiple specialized platforms, so exploring several options can help you identify which best serves your specific career needs.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"For professionals in highly specialized fields, these niche platforms often prove more effective than general job search platforms, as they connect you directly with employers who understand and value your unique expertise.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h2\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Networking-Focused Career Platforms\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"While traditional job search platforms focus primarily on job listings and applications, networking-focused career platforms take a different approach by prioritizing relationship building and professional connections as the primary pathway to career opportunities. These platforms recognize that many positions are filled through professional networks and referrals rather than traditional application processes.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Networking-centric platforms create digital ecosystems where professionals can showcase their expertise, engage with industry peers, and build meaningful relationships that often lead to career advancement. The emphasis shifts from submitting applications to building visibility and credibility within your professional community.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Building Professional Relationships Online\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"These platforms provide structured ways to connect with professionals in your field, participate in industry discussions, and demonstrate your knowledge through content sharing and engagement. By facilitating authentic professional interactions, they help job seekers become known within their industries before opportunities even arise.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Many professionals find that consistent engagement on networking platforms leads to inbound opportunities, where recruiters and hiring managers reach out directly based on profile visibility and demonstrated expertise. This approach transforms job searching from an active pursuit into a more passive process where opportunities come to you.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Community-Driven Career Development\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Networking platforms often feature industry-specific groups, discussion forums, and community spaces where professionals share insights, ask questions, and offer advice. These communities become valuable resources for learning about industry trends, discovering unadvertised opportunities, and gaining insider knowledge about companies and roles.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Active participation in these communities helps build your professional reputation and expand your network organically. The relationships formed through genuine engagement often prove more valuable than cold applications, as they come with built-in trust and mutual understanding of professional capabilities.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Leveraging Connections for Career Advancement\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"The most effective use of networking platforms involves strategic relationship building with a focus on providing value to your network. This might include sharing relevant industry content, offering helpful advice to peers, or connecting others who could benefit from knowing each other. These actions build social capital that can be invaluable during job searches.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"When you do need to activate your network for a job search, these existing relationships provide warm introductions to companies, insider referrals that bypass traditional application processes, and valuable information about company culture and role expectations that isn't available through standard job postings.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h2\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Remote Work and Flexible Job Specialized Platforms\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"The rise of remote and hybrid work has created a distinct category of job search platforms designed specifically for flexible work arrangements. These specialized platforms go beyond simply filtering for remote positions—they verify legitimacy, curate quality opportunities, and provide tools tailored to the unique needs of distributed teams and location-independent professionals.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"upload\",\"value\":{\"id\":183,\"site\":{\"id\":1,\"name\":\"Resume Coach\",\"slug\":\"resume-coach\",\"domains\":[{\"id\":\"6940625fb7e3150004f70abb\",\"domain\":\"resumecoach.me\"},{\"id\":\"6940625fb7e3150004f70abc\",\"domain\":\"www.resumecoach.me\"},{\"id\":\"81477e838b08aacb29e1efaf\",\"domain\":\"cms.resumecoach.me\"}],\"isDefault\":true,\"revalidateUrl\":null,\"revalidateSecret\":null,\"updatedAt\":\"2025-12-16T15:04:24.535Z\",\"createdAt\":\"2025-12-15T14:47:03.989Z\"},\"alt\":\"Professional utilizing remote work platforms from a modern home office setup\",\"prefix\":\"media\",\"updatedAt\":\"2026-02-20T14:06:07.253Z\",\"createdAt\":\"2026-02-20T14:06:07.250Z\",\"url\":\"/api/media/file/remote-work-job-platforms.png\",\"thumbnailURL\":null,\"filename\":\"remote-work-job-platforms.png\",\"mimeType\":\"image/png\",\"filesize\":1613591,\"width\":1024,\"height\":1024,\"focalX\":50,\"focalY\":50},\"fields\":{\"caption\":\"Remote work platforms enable professionals to find flexible opportunities worldwide.\"},\"format\":\"\",\"version\":3,\"relationTo\":\"media\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Unlike traditional employment websites that may include remote jobs as an afterthought, these platforms build their entire ecosystem around flexible work. They understand the nuances of remote hiring, from time zone considerations to communication preferences, and help both job seekers and employers navigate the complexities of distributed work arrangements.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"What Makes Remote-Focused Platforms Different\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Remote work platforms typically offer advanced filtering systems that go beyond the basic \\\"remote\\\" checkbox found on general job boards. You can often search by geographic restrictions, work arrangement type, communication expectations, travel requirements, and equipment support provided.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Many of these platforms also implement verification processes to screen out illegitimate postings. This is particularly valuable given the increase in remote work scams and misleading job descriptions that plague general job boards.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Key Features of Quality Remote Job Platforms\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"The best remote-focused platforms understand that location independence requires different information than traditional job searches. Look for platforms that provide transparent compensation details including whether salaries are location-adjusted or standardized globally, company remote maturity indicators showing whether an organization is remote-first or remote-friendly, and community sections offering guidance on home office setup and productivity tools.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Maximizing Your Remote Job Search\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"To get the most from remote-focused platforms, highlight your remote work experience and self-management capabilities prominently in your profile. Even if your previous roles weren't fully remote, emphasize any experience with distributed teams, asynchronous communication, or independent project management.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Be specific about your flexibility preferences. Some job seekers want complete location independence, while others prefer occasional in-person meetings or specific time zone alignment. Clear communication about your preferences helps platforms match you with appropriate opportunities.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h2\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Platforms for Entry-Level and Career Changers\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Breaking into a new field or launching your career can feel overwhelming, but specialized job search platforms are designed to support exactly these transitions. These platforms recognize that early-career professionals and career changers bring valuable potential, even when traditional experience is limited.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"The most effective platforms for this audience focus on transferable skills rather than rigid job history requirements. They help you identify how your existing abilities apply to new roles and industries, making it easier to position yourself as a viable candidate even when switching fields.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Skill-Building Integration\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Many entry-level and career-change platforms integrate learning opportunities directly into the job search experience. This approach allows you to build relevant skills while actively searching for opportunities, closing gaps in your resume in real-time.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"These platforms often partner with educational providers to offer courses, certifications, and micro-credentials that employers in your target field actually value. By completing these programs through the same platform where you're applying for jobs, you can immediately showcase new qualifications to potential employers.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Apprenticeship and Training Programs\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Some platforms specialize in connecting candidates with apprenticeship opportunities and structured training programs. These pathways provide hands-on experience while earning income, making them particularly valuable for career changers who need to develop practical skills in a new field.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Transferable Skills Matching\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Advanced platforms use matching algorithms that identify how skills from one industry or role translate to opportunities in another field. This technology is particularly valuable for career changers who may not realize how their background applies to new opportunities. By focusing on competencies rather than job titles, these platforms help you discover roles you might not have considered.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h2\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Executive and Senior-Level Career Platforms\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Senior professionals and executives require a different approach to job searching than early-career candidates. Platforms designed for executive-level opportunities prioritize discretion, quality over quantity, and personalized service that matches the complexity of high-level career transitions.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"These specialized platforms typically offer confidential search features that protect your current employment status while exploring new opportunities. Many executives need to conduct their search discreetly, and these platforms understand the sensitivity required when exploring senior-level moves.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Features of Executive Career Platforms\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Executive-focused platforms often provide curated opportunity matching rather than open job boards. Recruiters and headhunters actively use these platforms to identify qualified candidates for senior roles, which means your profile works for you even when you're not actively searching.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Many platforms in this category offer executive coaching services, leadership assessment tools, and career advisory support. These resources help senior professionals navigate complex career decisions, negotiate compensation packages, and position themselves effectively for board positions or C-suite roles.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"The Executive Search Experience\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Unlike general job search platforms, executive platforms often operate on a relationship-based model. Your profile may be reviewed by executive recruiters who specialize in specific industries or functional areas. This personalized approach ensures that opportunities presented to you align with your experience level, industry expertise, and career aspirations.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Confidentiality settings allow you to control who can view your profile and contact you. Some platforms enable you to block specific companies or industries from seeing your information, providing an additional layer of privacy protection during your search.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h2\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"How to Maximize Your Success on Job Search Platforms\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Successfully navigating job search platforms requires more than simply uploading a resume and clicking apply. Complete every section thoroughly, ensuring consistency across all platforms you use. Include a professional photo where appropriate, craft a compelling headline that clearly communicates your value proposition, and write a summary that highlights your key strengths and career objectives.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Use industry-specific terminology naturally throughout your profile. Many platforms use search algorithms that match candidate profiles with job postings based on keyword relevance, so incorporating relevant terms from your target job descriptions can increase your discoverability.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Optimizing for Applicant Tracking Systems\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) are software applications that help employers manage the recruitment process by filtering and ranking resumes. Understanding how to optimize your resume for these systems is essential for getting past initial screening stages.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"When creating your resume, use standard section headings like \\\"Work Experience,\\\" \\\"Education,\\\" and \\\"Skills\\\" rather than creative alternatives. Choose simple, clean formatting without tables, text boxes, or graphics that ATS software may struggle to parse correctly.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Incorporate relevant keywords from job descriptions naturally throughout your resume. Focus on including specific skills, certifications, and industry terms that match the positions you're targeting. However, avoid keyword stuffing, which can make your resume difficult to read for human reviewers.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Setting Up Strategic Job Alerts\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Most platforms offer customizable job alert features that notify you when new opportunities matching your criteria are posted. Configure alerts with specific parameters including job titles, locations, experience levels, and company types to ensure you receive relevant notifications without overwhelming your inbox.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Implementing a Multi-Platform Approach\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Relying on a single platform limits your exposure to opportunities. Develop a strategic presence across multiple job search platforms that align with your career goals, industry, and experience level. This diversified approach increases your chances of discovering opportunities that may only be posted on specific sites.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Tracking Your Applications Systematically\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Create a tracking system to monitor every application you submit. Engage with content, participate in relevant groups or discussions where available, and connect with professionals in your target industry. These activities increase your visibility and can lead to opportunities that aren't formally advertised.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h2\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Common Mistakes to Avoid When Using Employment Websites\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Navigating job search platforms effectively requires awareness of common pitfalls that can undermine your efforts. Diversifying your platform usage increases your exposure to opportunities and reduces the risk of missing relevant openings.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Neglecting Profile Completeness\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Incomplete profiles significantly reduce your visibility on job search platforms. Failing to optimize your resume for these systems means your application may never reach a recruiter.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Spray-and-Pray Application Approach\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Submitting generic applications to dozens of positions without customization rarely yields results. Quality applications tailored to specific roles consistently outperform high-volume, generic submissions. Focus on positions that genuinely match your qualifications and customize each application accordingly.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Not Utilizing Available Resources\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Most modern job search platforms offer valuable resources beyond job listings—skill assessments, resume builders, career advice articles, and networking opportunities. Explore all features your chosen platforms provide to maximize their value.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Forgetting to Set Up Alerts\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Many job seekers manually check platforms daily instead of configuring automated job alerts. Set up customized alerts based on your criteria to receive notifications as soon as relevant positions become available.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Overlooking Privacy Settings\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Failing to review privacy settings can create awkward situations, especially if you're currently employed. Most platforms allow you to control who sees your profile and activity. Configure these settings appropriately to maintain confidentiality.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Sources\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"list\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"type\":\"listitem\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"type\":\"link\",\"fields\":{\"url\":\"https://www.kforce.com/articles/how-to-write-your-resume-for-applicant-tracking-systems-ats\",\"linkType\":\"custom\"},\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"How to Write Your Resume for Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"}],\"listType\":\"bullet\",\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h2\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Comparing Platforms: How to Choose the Right One for You\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"With numerous job search platforms available, selecting the right ones for your specific situation requires a strategic approach. Rather than spreading yourself too thin across every platform, focus on those that align with your career stage, industry, and job search goals.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"upload\",\"value\":{\"id\":185,\"site\":{\"id\":1,\"name\":\"Resume Coach\",\"slug\":\"resume-coach\",\"domains\":[{\"id\":\"6940625fb7e3150004f70abb\",\"domain\":\"resumecoach.me\"},{\"id\":\"6940625fb7e3150004f70abc\",\"domain\":\"www.resumecoach.me\"},{\"id\":\"81477e838b08aacb29e1efaf\",\"domain\":\"cms.resumecoach.me\"}],\"isDefault\":true,\"revalidateUrl\":null,\"revalidateSecret\":null,\"updatedAt\":\"2025-12-16T15:04:24.535Z\",\"createdAt\":\"2025-12-15T14:47:03.989Z\"},\"alt\":\"Visual comparison of different job search platforms showing features and ratings\",\"prefix\":\"media\",\"updatedAt\":\"2026-02-20T14:06:12.269Z\",\"createdAt\":\"2026-02-20T14:06:12.269Z\",\"url\":\"/api/media/file/comparing-job-search-platforms.png\",\"thumbnailURL\":null,\"filename\":\"comparing-job-search-platforms.png\",\"mimeType\":\"image/png\",\"filesize\":1263548,\"width\":1024,\"height\":1024,\"focalX\":50,\"focalY\":50},\"fields\":{\"caption\":\"Comparing platforms helps you find the right fit for your career goals.\"},\"format\":\"\",\"version\":3,\"relationTo\":\"media\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Evaluate Based on Your Career Stage\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Your current career level should guide your platform selection. Entry-level candidates benefit from platforms that emphasize skill-building and transferable skills, while mid-career professionals should prioritize sites with strong industry connections. Senior-level job seekers often need platforms offering confidential search features and executive-level opportunities.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Consider Industry-Specific Requirements\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Some industries have specialized platforms that understand their unique hiring practices and terminology. General platforms work well for common roles across industries, but specialized fields like healthcare, technology, or creative services may require industry-focused sites.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Match Platforms to Your Job Type Preferences\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Your ideal work arrangement should influence your platform choices. If you're seeking remote work, prioritize platforms that specialize in verifying legitimate remote opportunities. For traditional office roles, general platforms with strong local employer networks may serve you better.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Create Your Personalized Platform Strategy\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Develop a multi-platform approach that covers your needs without overwhelming you. Most successful job seekers use a combination of three to five platforms: one or two general sites for broad reach, one industry-specific platform if applicable, and one focused on your preferred work arrangement.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h2\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Future Trends: What's Next for Career Websites Beyond career platforms will leverage AI, VR, and blockchain technologies.\"},\"format\":\"\",\"version\":3,\"relationTo\":\"media\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Deeper AI Personalization\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Artificial intelligence is moving beyond basic job matching to create truly personalized career experiences. Future platforms will likely analyze not just your resume and preferences, but also your work patterns, learning style, and long-term career aspirations.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Virtual and Augmented Reality Integration\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Virtual reality interviews and workplace tours are emerging as tools that allow candidates to experience company culture before accepting offers. These immersive technologies could help both job seekers and employers make more informed decisions.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Blockchain-Based Credentials\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Blockchain technology promises to revolutionize how professional credentials, certifications, and work history are verified. This could eliminate lengthy background checks and make it easier for candidates to prove their qualifications across borders and industries.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Predictive Career Pathing\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Advanced analytics are enabling platforms to offer predictive insights about career trajectories. By analyzing millions of career paths, these systems could suggest optimal next steps, identify skill gaps before they become barriers, and forecast which roles align best with individual career goals.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h3\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Enhanced Privacy and Data Control\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"As platforms collect more personal data to power these advanced features, privacy concerns are driving innovation in how candidate information is managed. Future platforms will likely offer more granular control over data sharing and transparent algorithms that explain why specific opportunities are recommended.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h2\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Frequently Asked Questions\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"What's the difference between free and paid features on job search platforms?\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":1}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Most job search platforms offer basic functionality at no cost, including job searches, profile creation, and standard applications. Paid features typically provide enhanced visibility, priority application placement, advanced search filters, and additional resume tools.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"How do job search platforms protect my privacy?\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":1}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Reputable employment websites implement security measures to protect your personal information. Most platforms allow you to control profile visibility, choose whether to make your resume searchable by recruiters, and manage communication preferences.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Can I track my applications across multiple platforms?\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":1}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"While some comprehensive career platforms offer built-in application tracking, many job seekers find it helpful to maintain their own tracking system using a spreadsheet or dedicated job search organization tool.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Will employers see my profile if I'm currently employed?\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":1}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Most job search platforms offer privacy controls that let you limit profile visibility. You can typically set your profile to \\\"private\\\" or \\\"anonymous\\\" mode, which prevents your current employer from viewing your job search activity.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"How often should I update my profile on job search platforms?\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":1}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Regular profile updates signal to platform algorithms and recruiters that you're an active candidate. Aim to refresh your profile at least monthly, even with minor updates like adding new skills or refining your job preferences.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Should I apply through the platform or directly on company websites?\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":1}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Both approaches have merit. Applying through the platform ensures your application enters the company's applicant tracking system and may provide easier tracking. However, some employers prefer direct applications through their career pages.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"How do I know if a job posting is legitimate?\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":1}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Legitimate job postings typically include detailed job descriptions, clear company information, realistic salary ranges, and professional contact details. Be cautious of postings that require upfront payments, promise unrealistic earnings, or request sensitive personal information early in the process.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"tag\":\"h2\",\"type\":\"heading\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Conclusion\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Navigating today's job market requires more than just submitting applications—it demands a strategic approach to the platforms you use. Throughout my career coaching sessions, I've consistently observed that candidates who thoughtfully select and leverage multiple job search platforms see significantly better outcomes than those who rely on a single source.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"The landscape of employment websites has transformed into a sophisticated ecosystem where AI-powered matching, comprehensive career resources, and networking opportunities converge. Whether you're exploring industry-specific platforms, remote work hubs, or comprehensive career ecosystems, the key is understanding which tools align with your unique career stage, industry, and goals.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"Take time to evaluate your options strategically. Build complete, ATS-optimized profiles across your chosen platforms. Set up targeted alerts. Engage with the skill-building and networking resources available. And most importantly, approach your job search with the understanding that these platforms are tools—powerful ones when used effectively, but only as effective as the strategy behind them.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"},{\"type\":\"paragraph\",\"version\":1,\"children\":[{\"mode\":\"normal\",\"text\":\"The right job search platform can make a significant difference in your career journey. By combining the insights from this guide with a personalized, multi-platform approach, you'll position yourself to discover opportunities that truly align with your professional aspirations and maximize your success in the competitive job market.\",\"type\":\"text\",\"style\":\"\",\"detail\":0,\"format\":0}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"}],\"direction\":\"ltr\"}},\"categories\":[{\"id\":66,\"title\":\"Job Search Johnson\",\"slug\":\"emily-johnson\",\"bio\":\"Emily Johnson is a seasoned career strategist with over a decade of experience in recruitment and talent acquisition. Her career began in human resources, where she quickly recognized her knack for identifying talent and aligning individuals with their dream roles. Over the years, Emily has helped thousands of professionals refine their job search strategies, from crafting compelling resumes to mastering the nuances of interview tactics. ## Lexical JSON Table of Contents Format

Here is the exact correct format your AI content generator should produce for the Table of Contents section. This is the format that **works** with Payload's Lexical editor and renders correctly on the frontend with clickable anchor links:

**Structure**: `h2` heading + `list` (bullet) of `listitem` > `paragraph` > `link` nodes

```json
{
  "tag": "h2",
  "type": "heading",
  "version": 1,
  "children": [
    {
      "mode": "normal",
      "text": "Table of Contents",
      "type": "text",
      "style": "",
      "detail": 0,
      "format": 0
    }
  ],
  "direction": "ltr"
}
```

Followed immediately by the list:

```json
{
  "type": "list",
  "listType": "bullet",
  "version": 1,
  "children": [
    {
      "type": "listitem",
      "version": 1,
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "paragraph",
          "version": 1,
          "children": [
            {
              "type": "link",
              "version": 1,
              "fields": {
                "url": "#section-slug-here",
                "linkType": "custom"
              },
              "children": [
                {
                  "mode": "normal",
                  "text": "Section Title Here",
                  "type": "text",
                  "style": "",
                  "detail": 0,
                  "format": 0
                }
              ],
              "direction": "ltr"
            }
          ],
          "direction": "ltr"
        }
      ],
      "direction": "ltr"
    }
  ],
  "direction": "ltr",
  "start": 1,
  "tag": "ul"
}
```

**Key rules for your AI writer:**

1. **Each TOC entry** must be: `listitem` > `paragraph` > `link` (not just `listitem` > `link` or `listitem` > `text`)
2. **The link `url`** must be a `#` anchor matching the heading slug: `#` + heading text lowercased, spaces replaced with `-`, non-alphanumeric removed
3. **`linkType` must be `"custom"`** (not `"internal"`)
4. **Slug generation function**: `text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '')`
5. **Every node needs `"version": 1`** and text nodes need `"mode": "normal"`, `"detail": 0`, `"format": 0`, `"style": ""`
6. **The `list` node** needs `"listType": "bullet"`, `"tag": "ul"`, `"start": 1`
7. **Only include `h2` headings** in the TOC (not h3 subheadings) to keep it readable

**Example slug mappings:**
- "How Job Search Platforms Have Evolved in 2026" -> `#how-job-search-platforms-have-evolved-in-2026`
- "AI-Powered Matching Platforms: Precision Over Volume" -> `#ai-powered-matching-platforms-precision-over-volume`
- "What's Next for Career Websites" -> `#whats-next-for-career-websites`
